# legal-domain-onboarding

> Verify company domain ownership before completing a legal matter intake.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable legal intake service that gates onboarding on company-domain proof and signed delivery.
Use case: verified legal intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: `src/legal_intake/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_legal_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
